description: Figure 7 is a line plot that compares the performance of different query selection strategies for the CAPSTONE model, evaluated on the MRR@10 metric. The x-axis represents the "Number of queries used during inference (S)", ranging from 2 to 10 in increments of 2. The y-axis represents the "MRR@10" score, ranging from 33.0 to 36.5. The plot displays six different strategies, each represented by a distinct line with a corresponding marker and color, as detailed in the legend: DPR w/o query (black solid line), DPR w/ gold (yellow circle), DPR w/ top-1 (green circle), DPR w/ bottom-1 (purple circle), DPR w/ random (blue circle), and DPR w/ curriculum (red circle). The performance of the DPR w/o query strategy (black solid line) remains constant at approximately 34.0 across all values of S. The DPR w/ gold strategy (yellow line) shows a steady increase from about 33.0 to 34.0. The DPR w/ top-1 strategy (green line) starts at 33.0 and increases to approximately 36.4. The DPR w/ bottom-1 strategy (purple line) starts at 34.5 and remains relatively stable, fluctuating slightly around 34.5. The DPR w/ random strategy (blue line) starts at 34.5 and increases to about 35.2. The DPR w/ curriculum strategy (red line) starts at 35.0 and increases to approximately 35.8. The caption indicates that solid lines represent results with corpus expansion, and dotted lines represent results with the typical representation.
